svg.title: Libris — Borrow requests
svg.desc: Approve or decline student requests; the copy changes status only on approval.

g.text: Review what students have asked to borrow. A copy is only marked Borrowed after approval.
The 14-day loan starts at approval. If two students request the same copy, approving one declines the other automatically.
A request does not reserve the copy.
The student picks an available copy
Approve to issue, or decline to keep it
The loan clock and due date begin
